description: This file defines classes, macros, and functions related to warning reporting control within a software project. It includes mechanisms for categorizing warnings, serializing/deserializing warning data, and managing warning categories and their configurations. The file also contains macros for reporting warnings, out-of-bounds warnings, and duration warnings, as well as classes for thread-local storage of callsigns and a proxy for warning reporting units.

classes.name: CallsignTLS
classes.description: Manages thread-local storage for callsigns used in warning reporting, including setting, getting, and thread safety mechanisms.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy
classes.description: Singleton proxy class that manages warning reporting events, category configurations, and handlers.

classes.name: WarningReportingBoundsCategory
classes.description: Template class that manages warning bounds and analysis for specific categories and value types.

classes.name: WarningReportingType
classes.description: Template class that encapsulates warning category behavior, including analysis, serialization, and warning status.

methods.name: Callsign
methods.description: Returns the current thread-local callsign used in warning reports.

methods.name: Callsign
methods.description: Sets the thread-local callsign for warning reports.

methods.name: Callsign
methods.description: Returns the callsign stored in thread-local storage.

methods.name: Callsign
methods.description: Sets the callsign in thread-local storage.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of WarningReportingUnitProxy.

methods.name: ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Reports a warning event with specified details.

methods.name: IsDefaultCategory
methods.description: Checks if a category is enabled by default and retrieves its specific name.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Announces a new warning category control.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures warning bounds and settings for a category.

methods.name: CategoryName
methods.description: Returns the name of the warning category.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes warning category data into a buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes warning category data from a buffer.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts warning category data to a string representation.

methods.name: IsWarning
methods.description: Determines if the current value is considered a warning based on bounds.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Checks if the warning category is enabled.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Sets the enabled state of the warning category.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Destroys or deregisters the warning category control.
